node.title: L1 official maximal split-value complement census
node.statement: For every actual split-value degree 2<=h<=m=floor(n/p) in an official first-checkpoint Frobenius pencil, the degree-u complement C, u=n-hp, uniquely determines the normalized perturbation Q. At depth d, its top d-p nonleading coefficients vanish, so with ell_h=u-d+p there are at most floor(binom(n,ell_h)/binom(u,ell_h)) normalized records and binom(h,2) times that many unordered fiber pairs. After depressing the outer polynomial, polynomial Mason-Stothers gives ord_0(R)<=u-p or u e_h<=p, where h e_h+1=0 mod p. At h=m all 16 official m>=3 rows violate the only possible arm, so maximal capacity is empty at every depth. The lower-h exponent can still grow; higher tail widths and the full L1 fiber remain open.
